title: spec/appendix-ccp12-hopping.md: Missing validation of announce_rx_channel allows out-of-bounds channel selection
description:
The Python priority chain code returns announce_rx_channel directly without validating it is within valid range (0 to n_channels-1). A malicious peer can advertise an arbitrary channel number in their Announce message, causing receivers to attempt tuning to non-existent channels. This could cause undefined behavior in radio hardware, denial of service, or array index out-of-bounds crashes in implementations that use channel as an array index.

Fix suggestion: Add validation before returning: if 0 <= announce_rx_channel < n_channels: return announce_rx_channel
close_reason: Fixed: Added bounds validation (0 <= announce_rx_channel < n_channels) before returning announce-driven channel. Invalid channels now fall through to the next priority level with a warning log. Added test coverage for negative, equal-to-n_channels, and large invalid channel values.
